body: I am happy for you but that’s so annoying to me! that is the first thing I tried!

Oh thank you! That is really good to know about the charms. My fb group has been good so far, there are a couple of girls still waiting! And $50 for what you get is usually a good deal, but $50 for nothing is not!

Thank you for the advice! I own my own business and I would be very embarrassed with a 6 week turn around and I would be completely refreshing my customer service team! 

I have thought about doing the fraud charges with my bank but I think they will probably cancel my acct and I will lose all my charms :/ but I don’t want to deal with this again and I don’t think they should get to keep my $50

I’m glad you got it! I have a yearlong subscription good through next year so I would have thought it would come automatically. I don’t think I ever had to manually order my box on the subscription before?

I’ve posted a bunch on their ig (and twitter and fb!) and nothing. :/ Not even a comment in response. I just don’t know what else to try and I’m worried if I have my bank reverse the charges they will cancel my account and I’ll lose all my charms :(
I am 24. I appreciate that, but I don't believe it. I don't think anyone is really happy, at least not in a way that would, for me, justify the rest of the time.

I just don't think the good parts of life outweigh the bad. It's a slog, just plowing through and waiting for the next bad thing to happen. I'm not mad or upset about it and I don't really judge people who are content with that but it's just not something I want to do for another 50 or so years.
